- When sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next period.
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 85), model often overshoots and fails to correct; cap forecast at +5% above peak or use 3-period moving average for smoothing.
- If sentiment turns negative (≤0.33) within 3–5 days, model overreacts; apply downward bias of 2–4% for 2–3 periods ahead.
- Model exhibits strong mean reversion bias: if 3-period average of forecast is > 82, reduce by 1–2% per period until convergence to 80–82 range.
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently overpredicts early in the window (first 5–7 days); apply 1–2% downward adjustment for first 5 days.
- When sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67), model is prone to oscillation; use weighted average of 2-period sentiment + 3-period price average to stabilize forecast.
